neighbours.label: ' you' as the reader addressed in a hedged suggestion or guess about them (Maybe you…, I imagine you…, Perhaps you…), not 'you' in conditions, objects or set phrases
fire: I switched to a standing desk last year. Maybe you should try one.
The new café on the corner is lovely. Perhaps you know it already.
It rained all week here, and I imagine you had the same weather.
I finally read the book. Maybe you would enjoy it as well.
That exam was brutal, and I suspect you felt it too.
We moved our savings to a new bank. Perhaps you could do the same.
The traffic was awful today; I bet you were stuck in it too.
I gave up sugar for a month. Maybe you will want to join me.
quiet: I switched to a standing desk last year. Thank you for the tip.
The new café on the corner is lovely. They told you about it already.
It rained all week here, so call me if you need an umbrella.
I finally read the book you lent me last year.
That exam was brutal, and the teacher warned you about it.
We moved our savings to a new bank. Did they send you a letter?
The traffic was awful today, so the bus left without you.
I gave up sugar for a month. My sister joined me.

predictions: fire 0.4-0.8 on ' you' after maybe/perhaps/I imagine; 'you' in if-clauses, as object or in 'thank you' below 0.1
short: ' you' in 'maybe you / I imagine you'
notes: Card: ' you' x6 ('Maybe you should too', 'I imagine you feel'), ' will', ' same'. Probe: 'Maybe you should too' 0.766 and 'Maybe you should read it' 0.766 (fires on ' you', before the ending), 'I imagine you feel' 0.451; 'If you agree' 0.053, 'then did the same' 0.062, 'so did I' 0.043.
